x-http.notes: Create a client in Green Invoice (Postman collection mapping). Feature 026: name/email/phone now all required, address removed, and this tool now requires explicit approval (require_approval.always) instead of executing immediately (reverses Feature 022's exemption). No proactive duplicate-name/tax_id check ('try and fail' - analysis 2026-07-29); any real-API rejection propagates via the existing friendly-error mapping. Output MUST NOT include the internal client_id (REQ-CLIENT-018) - corrects the existing confirmation string which currently leaks it.

email.description: Validated via EmailStr/email-validator before any network call.

phone.description: Normalized to Israeli local dashed format (0XX-XXXXXXX) before being sent to Morning.

tax_id.description: Optional. Validated server-side by Morning (checksum, errorCode 1111) - not duplicated client-side.
